links.outcome: Readability (Flesch Reading Ease) of ChatGPT-generated patient education materials
links.effect: Median Flesch Reading Ease Score 48.2 (Q1-Q3: 39-50.65), indicating text understandable by a college student rather than a general patient audience.
links.quote: The median Flesch Reading Ease Score was 48.2 (Q1-Q3: 39-50.65).

unlisted_practices: Checking text similarity/plagiarism of AI-generated patient education materials before use

screen.reason: The study empirically tests the capability and readability of ChatGPT for creating patient education materials on Indian public health topics, but it only benchmarks raw model outputs without evaluating specific deployment safeguards or comparative practices.
